outcomes.name: The readiness and planning approach has been refined based on pilot learnings
The readiness and planning approach is understood across every site/team joining the scaled rollout

actions.action: Review pilot feedback on Planning & Risk to identify what needs to change in the readiness and planning approach before scaling.
Refine the readiness and planning approach to Planning & Risk based on lessons learned from the pilot.
Secure sign-off for the refined readiness and planning approach covering Planning & Risk ahead of wider rollout.
Ensure the refined readiness and planning approach for Planning & Risk is consistently communicated to new sites/teams joining the rollout.
Continuously validate that the readiness and planning approach for Planning & Risk remains effective as the change scales further.
Gather feedback from pilot participants on how the readiness and planning approach affected Strategic Direction & Leadership.
Adapt the readiness and planning approach relating to Strategic Direction & Leadership for a wider, more diverse audience.
Roll out the readiness and planning approach covering Strategic Direction & Leadership to stakeholders in newly onboarding sites/teams.
Monitor Strategic Direction & Leadership among stakeholders in the wider rollout and address any gaps.
Use champions from the pilot to help new sites/teams connect with the readiness and planning approach for Strategic Direction & Leadership.
